description: This file defines the TableStyle class which encapsulates various styling options for table formatting in PHPSpreadsheet. It contains constants for predefined style names, properties for style customization (theme, column/row stripes, etc.), and methods to get/set these properties.

classes.name: TableStyle
classes.description: Represents styling options for tables including theme, stripe visibility, and predefined style constants.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new TableStyle with a specified theme (e.g., TableStyle::TABLE_STYLE_MEDIUM2).

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Returns the current theme used by the table style.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the theme for the table style.

methods.name: getShowFirstColumn
methods.description: Returns boolean indicating if the first column should be styled/shown distinctly.

methods.name: setShowFirstColumn
methods.description: Sets whether the first column should be styled/shown distinctly.

methods.name: getShowLastColumn
methods.description: Returns boolean indicating if the last column should be styled/shown distinctly.

methods.name: setShowLastColumn
methods.description: Sets whether the last column should be styled/shown distinctly.

methods.name: getShowRowStripes
methods.description: Returns boolean indicating if row stripes are enabled.

methods.name: getShowColumnStripes
methods.description: Returns boolean indicating if column stripes are enabled.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the Table object associated with this style, if set.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Associates a Table object with this style.
